title: compile-check
summary: Runs a compiler-backed check against a single Delphi project (.dproj) or source file (.pas) and reports the result

surfaces.usage: drag-lint compile-check <target.dproj|.pas> [--project <X.dproj>] [--db PATH] [--format json|text] (no --db: caches only into the project's unique manifest owner, else reports uncached)
